text_block_list.text: I'm working in my office one day, when...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Trainer... Sorry to ask so suddenly,
but may I
take a day off training today?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
During lunch, I caught a dear pony when
she
missed a step on the stairs and
almost fell.
choice_data_list: Did something happen?
Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I hurt my foot in the process, and I don't
think I
should run on it today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can still walk fine,
so there's no need. I just want
to be safe and rest for today.
I'll see you
tomorrow.
choice_data_list: Are you all right? Want me to walk...
Are you okay? Want me to walk you ...

text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling she's playing it cool in
order not
to worry anyone, especially
the student she
helped.

But there's a possibility Fuji Kiseki's
injury could get worse. I want to respect
her judgment, so I "casually" grab some
get-well gifts for her from the school
store.

I get some of her favorite snacks and
arrange them in a bag so they hide the
medicated
bandages I slipped in there.
And then...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh hey! You're Fuji's trainer, right?
What can I do
for you?
choice_data_list: Excuse me, do you have a moment?
Excuse me, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow, it's stuffed with yummy snacks! She must be starving!
choice_data_list: Could you bring what Fuji forgot t...
Could you bring what Fuji forgot t...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'll get this to her in a jiffy, don't you
worry!

The words are hardly out of her mouth
before
she's running off.

I'm sure Fuji won't hesitate to accept a
delivery
from someone as pure and
innocent as Haru
Urara.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The swelling's gone down, but I
probably
shouldn't go patrolling the
dorm just yet.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Funny how I'm hiding away to conceal an
injury
again, just like when I was a kid...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(That time, I'd hurt myself during
rehearsal right before a show. I wanted
to whine and cry so
badly, like a regular
kid.)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(But since I was an actor first and
foremost, the
show had to go on...)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Fuji! I was looking for you! You've got a
parcel
from Urara's Special Delivery
Service!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Why, if you aren't just the most
adorable
mail courier in the world!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Heehee! ♪ Your trainer said you forgot
this and
asked me to deliver it to you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Be careful not to forget your stuff next
time,
'kay? Bye-bye!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hm, I'm sure I didn't leave anything
behind. Let's
see here... It's full of food
and... Ah, I see.
The next day...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's all better now, thanks to the little
delivery I
received from Urara.
choice_data_list: Looks like you're all better now, huh.
Looks like you're all better now, ...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's all better now, thanks to the little
delivery I
received from Urara.
choice_data_list: I wish you'd rely on me, at least.
I'd like you to let yourself lean ...
We help each other out in times of...
We help each other out in times of...

text_block_list.text:
As Fuji Kiseki's trainer and a grown
adult, I have a
responsibility to take care
of her, after all.
choice_data_list: I wish you'd rely on me, at least.
I'd like you to let yourself lean ...
We help each other out in times of...
We help each other out in times of...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thank you for saying that. It's a
relief
knowing how dependable you are.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was a child actor, I hurt
myself pretty
badly. My injury yesterday
reminded me of that
time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I bet things would've gone differently
back then if
you had been there for me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You definitely were.
choice_data_list: Was I able to be of some support t...
Was I able to support you, even ju...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Sigh. You're becoming more and more wily every day, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You keep spoiling me and chipping away
at my disguise. You'd better take
responsibility if I
become incapable of
being without you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! I'm just messing with you. ♪
Come on,
let's start training!
choice_data_list: T-That's...!

text_block_list.text:
I stare helplessly as she strolls off. If
anyone is
wily, it's definitely Fuji Kiseki
and not me.

I stare helplessly as she strolls off. If
anyone is
wily, it's definitely Fuji Kiseki
and not me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm, that is a good point.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll be sure to bring you something if you
ever get
injured, then.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can make you lots of nutritious food in
my
dorm's kitchen, now that I think of it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then I'd just have to visit you in secret,
so as to
ensure no one finds out.
choice_data_list: I'm flattered, but... your fans mi...
I'm flattered, but... your fans mi...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You could be my Juliet, and I, your
forbidden
Romeo...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You'd wait for me then, wouldn't you,
my fair
Juliet? ♪

I'm not sure if I should be looking
forward to or
dreading being put in that
situation...

But despite my mixed feelings, she looks
so
cheerful that I can't help but smile
back.
